glossary.sentence: UPT for the current month is calculated using the inventory readings, and purchases for the previous month.
Sales tax is calculated automatically but can be changed in the Cash Sheet Entry Section.
glossary.article: How Do I Reconstruct a Business Day (RBD)

glossary.sentence: Negative values shown in red Total variance color reflects the net result Positive + Negative Variance = Total Variance Aggregated across all variance-eligible categories Total Variance can drill down into the variance report Benefit :
New - WRINs that have been in the system for 10 days or less Obsolete - This tag is determined by the last purchase date and shelf life Check the box next to "View ONLY duplicate Prefix WRINs,".
An Obsolete WRIN is defined as any WRIN that has its most recent delivery date or transfer date into any given restaurant exceed the number of days of that WRINs Shelf Life.
The bell icon represents alerts.
glossary.article: How Do I Manage MyQSRSoft Alerts - Quick Start Guide

glossary.sentence: The overall score is the average of the scores in the 2 sections.
glossary.article: What are the MyQSRSoft Dashboard Features

glossary.sentence: Shift Prep - The score is the average for the shift runner between Travel Paths and Pre-Shift Checklists.
glossary.article: Role-Based / Shift Manager Tablet / MyQSRSoft Dashboard

glossary.sentence: Shift Operational Metrics - The score is the average of the scores in the 4 service metrics:
glossary.article: Role-Based / Shift Manager Tablet / MyQSRSoft Dashboard

glossary.sentence: The overall score for each metric is the average of all the shifts each person ran.
glossary.article: Role-Based / Shift Manager Tablet / MyQSRSoft Dashboard

glossary.sentence: This is a blend of various sales, service, and labor measures down to the quarter-hour level.
glossary.article: Role-Based / Shift Manager Tablet / MyQSRSoft Dashboard

glossary.sentence: The name of the form The date of the form The locations to choose CoachQ available on this page Filter Results Button Each time you click the Filter Results button you may choose a different question from the dropdown with it's accompanying answer range, like Equals, Contains.
Register Audit Summary of various cash control measures with drill-down to the drawer level.
The monthly turnover is multiplied by 12 to make it comparable to an annual number Shift The Shift Report is an expansion of the Shift Section.
New hires that did stay for at least 90 days are called "3-Month Retained". "3-Month Turnover" is 3-Month Terms divided by total hires in that 3-month period.

In-store includes Front Counter & Kiosk Front Counter (FC) includes Front Counter registers, Delivery and MOP (attended, unattended and curbside) Sales Ledger Summary This report provides sales measures at a full day resolution.
YYNN A report designed to help report on 2 key measures - OEPE and Transaction growth in Drive Thru.
Daily Activity Report (DAR) The Daily Activity Report is a blend of various sales, service, and labor measures down to the quarter hour level.
Focus On Service This report helps correlate Labor Hours used with sales and service measures.
Question What is the 2 nd side formula?
If 38 items were sold in a quarter hour, each side would need to prep 8 items in order to get 100%.(38 * 0.2 = 7.6 rounded up to 8) If both sides do not prep at least 8 items, it would show 0%.
